# Linkedin Ads

LinkedIn Marketing and Advertising API for managing ad campaigns, analytics, and organization social content

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/linkedin-ads/.

## Actions

- **Create Ad Account**: Create a new LinkedIn ad account for campaign management.
- **Create Lead Form**: Create a new LinkedIn lead generation form for ads.
- **Get Ad Account** (read-only): Retrieve a specific LinkedIn Ad Account by ID.
- **Get Ad Supply Forecasts** (read-only): Retrieve supply forecasts for LinkedIn ad inventory based on targeting criteria, budget, and bid settings.
- **Get Campaign Group** (read-only): Retrieve a specific LinkedIn Ads campaign group by ID.
- **Get lead form by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a specific LinkedIn lead form by its ID.
- **Get organization access control list** (read-only): Retrieve organization access control list showing who has admin or poster rights for organizations.
- **Get Targeting Entities** (read-only): Retrieve targeting entities for LinkedIn Ads campaigns.
- **Get Targeting Facets** (read-only): Retrieve available ad targeting facets including industries, locations, seniorities, job functions, skills, and more.
- **List Conversion Rules** (read-only): List all conversion rules for a LinkedIn ad account.
- **List DMP Segments** (read-only): List DMP (Data Management Platform) segments for LinkedIn ad accounts.
- **List LinkedIn posts** (read-only): List LinkedIn posts by author or retrieve multiple posts by IDs.
- **List Organizations** (read-only): Search and list LinkedIn organizations by IDs, vanity name, or parent organization.
- **Search Ad Accounts** (read-only): Search for LinkedIn ad accounts with filtering by status, type, and test mode.
- **Search LinkedIn Ads Creatives** (read-only): Search and list LinkedIn Ads creatives with filtering options.
- **Get Ad Analytics** (read-only): Retrieve LinkedIn ad analytics and reporting metrics for campaigns, creatives, and accounts.
- **Get Audience Counts** (read-only): Get estimated audience size for given targeting criteria on LinkedIn Ads.
- **Get organization follower count** (read-only): Retrieve follower count for a LinkedIn organization.
- **Get organization follower statistics** (read-only): Retrieve follower growth statistics for a LinkedIn organization.
- **Get organization page statistics** (read-only): Retrieve page view and click statistics for a LinkedIn organization page.
- **Get organization share statistics** (read-only): Retrieve share and engagement statistics for an organization's content on LinkedIn.
- **List Lead Forms** (read-only): List LinkedIn lead forms for an organization or by specific IDs.
- **Lookup organizations** (read-only): Batch lookup organization details by IDs without requiring admin access.
- **Register Upload**: Register an upload for media assets (images, videos) on LinkedIn.
- **Search Campaigns** (read-only): Search and list campaigns in a LinkedIn Ads account with filtering options.
- **Search Events** (read-only): Search and list LinkedIn events by organizer with filtering options.
- **Update lead form**: Update an existing LinkedIn lead form.
- **Update organization access control**: Update organization access control for a user on LinkedIn.
